SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-11: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — View Runner, Examples. Test these items: execute a ViewDefinition and return tabular rows, simple Patient and Observation example views, unrolling arrays such as Patient.address into row sets, filtered Observation/resource views, column type coercion into DuckDB result columns, official SQL-on-FHIR v2 spec_tests parity, parser, generator, and DuckDB execution agree for supported examples. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2 ViewDefinition: View Runner; ViewDefinition.select.column.type definition; ViewDefinition.select.forEach; ViewDefinition.select.column.collection/type mismatch reporting
issues.evidence: Fresh probe fhir4ds-private/docs/prompts/.ai_loop/.temp/qa/sof_vd11_explorer_probe.py fails before remediation. A valid forEach over Observation.component.value with column path $this and type integer raises DuckDB BinderException: Cannot mix DOUBLE and VARCHAR in COALESCE. Invalid iterator projections such as component.value/$this declared as string and %rowIndex declared as string silently return coerced values instead of a type mismatch. Spec says a ViewDefinition is a tabular projection executed by a View Runner, forEach produces rows for selected elements, and column.type should report an error if the returned type does not match.
issues.root_cause: SQLGenerator disabled runtime type checks in iterator contexts because FHIRPath type().name metadata can be backend-dependent on unrolled JSON fragments. The fallback physical-shape guard was missing, and the direct $this branch mixed numeric/Boolean UDF output with a VARCHAR fallback. The %rowIndex fast path also accepted incompatible declared column types.
issues.resolution: Added physical JSON type guards for iterator contexts where metadata guards are disabled; fixed $this expression generation so numeric/Boolean typed columns do not build mixed COALESCE SQL; added static %rowIndex declared-type validation and decimal/integer-compatible casts; added native/fallback integration regressions and a fresh EXPLORER probe.
